title: The Biggest Eyes on Earth Don't Belong to a Whale
subject: colossal squid

scenes.text: The biggest eyes on Earth don't belong to a whale. They belong to the dark.
The colossal squid. The biggest ones weigh more than half a ton.
Each eye is at least twenty-seven centimeters across, about the size of a soccer ball, and possibly more.
It lives hundreds of meters down, in water where sunlight barely reaches.
Its arms are lined with hooks, and the hooks on its two long tentacles rotate.
The largest eyes in the animal kingdom, built for the dark.

description:
The largest eyes in the animal kingdom belong to the colossal squid, not a whale.
Each eye is about 27 centimeters across or more, around the size of a soccer ball. The squid can weigh over half a ton, lives deep in the ocean, and has hooks on its arms and swiveling hooks on its tentacles.
Could you spot one in the dark? Comment below.
thumbnail_text: EYES BIGGER THAN A SOCCER BALL
first_comment: Estimates of the eye size range from about 27 to 40 centimeters. Would you want to meet this squid?
